entries.subject: pty-throughput
entries.title: Terminal output into the window
entries.passMark: No lost bytes, echo under 100 ms, memory under 300 MB
entries.summary: No terminal output is dropped and typing echoes with no noticeable delay; memory during heavy bursts missed the original limit.

measured.label: Bytes received
measured.value: Full payload in every pane, plus a 1 to 7 byte surplus whose source is not identified; never a deficit

measured.label: Peak memory
measured.value: 492 MB at 256 KiB high-water; 789 MB at 1 MiB

entries.subject: libghostty-vt
entries.title: Terminal snapshots from Ghostty’s engine
entries.passMark: Clean cargo build under 5 minutes on a clean runner, and a plain-text vim snapshot that matches
entries.summary: Ghostty's engine builds within its time budget and captures a vim screen snapshot that matches what was typed.

measured.label: Clean build
measured.value: 42 s on macOS 27 with Homebrew zig@0.15

measured.label: Vim snapshot
measured.value: First line equals the typed text

entries.subject: reviewer-readonly-codex
entries.title: A Codex reviewer cannot write
entries.passMark: The write is refused and the refusal shows in the output
entries.summary: A read-only Codex probe is stopped by the operating system when it tries to change a file, and says so.

measured.label: target.txt after the probe
measured.value: Unchanged; blocked by the OS sandbox

entries.subject: reviewer-readonly-claude
entries.title: A Claude Code reviewer cannot write
entries.passMark: The write is refused and the refusal shows in the output
entries.summary: Will check that a Claude Code reviewer is refused when it tries to change a file.

entries.subject: reviewer-readonly-gemini
entries.title: A Gemini CLI reviewer cannot write
entries.passMark: The write is refused and the refusal shows in the output
entries.summary: Will check that a Gemini CLI reviewer is refused when it tries to change a file.

entries.subject: pty-memory
entries.title: Terminal memory trip-wires
entries.passMark: Idle under 150 MB, and burst peak under 600 MB at the 1 MiB high-water mark, in the real TerminalPort
entries.summary: Will check that the real terminal stays within new memory limits, both at rest and during heavy output.

entries.subject: local-worker-gpt-oss
entries.title: A local 120B model as a third worker
entries.passMark: Answers a warm prompt within 30 s and finds the known defect in a real review, within 10 minutes
entries.summary: Through Codex the model ran out of GPU memory on every request; called directly it answered but missed the real defect.

measured.label: Through Codex
measured.value: No answer at 131k or 40k context; Metal out of memory

measured.label: Direct Ollama call, 8k context
measured.value: 2,758 prompt tokens, 113.5 s, missed the defect, 2 of 4 findings false

measured.label: Cloud Codex, same review
measured.value: Found the defect twice, in 29 s and 100 s

entries.subject: crew-harness
entries.title: Crew protocol test harness
entries.passMark: Every harness behaviour is proven by a test that failed first, and the typecheck is clean
entries.summary: The harness that runs the crew test validates crew files, runs each task in its own worktree, stops loops and scores against one agent alone.

measured.label: Real preflight
measured.value: Codex and Ollama answered; stopped on the revoked Claude login, as designed

entries.subject: m0-foundation
entries.title: M0: stack and UI foundation
entries.passMark: The three stack spikes have results, and the Task screen is merged with its checks passing
entries.summary: The stack spikes have results and the Task screen runs on kbui 0.4.0, but the screen is not merged yet.

measured.label: Stack spikes
measured.value: Terminal output partial, snapshots pass, Codex read-only pass

measured.label: Task screen
measured.value: 37 unit and 62 browser tests pass on kbui 0.4.0, in bezl #3

entries.subject: m1-crew-test
entries.title: M1: crew test
entries.passMark: 4 of 5 tasks green with only a merge from the operator, no cap or loop stops, crew tokens at most twice one agent alone, and at least one real defect caught in review
entries.summary: Will test whether a writer and a reviewer coordinated by Bezl beat one agent working alone.

entries.subject: m2-domain-core
entries.title: M2: domain core
entries.passMark: Tests cover the writer lease, every state transition and rebuilding a task from its log, and a second writer on a worktree is refused
entries.summary: Will build the task rules in Rust: one writer per worktree, events in an append-only log.

entries.subject: m3-providers
entries.title: M3: providers and preflight
entries.passMark: The Providers screen shows real preflight results for every installed CLI, and every provider Bezl offers has a read-only probe result
entries.summary: Will show which agent CLIs are installed, signed in, and how far each can be trusted.

entries.subject: m4-live-terminals
entries.title: M4: live terminals
entries.passMark: Three panes stream 20 MB each with no lost bytes, idle memory under 150 MB and bursts under 600 MB
entries.summary: Will stream real agent sessions into Task panels within the memory limits.

entries.subject: m5-first-task
entries.title: M5: first real task, end to end
entries.passMark: A real task finishes with a writer and a read-only reviewer, one approval is answered in the app, and the evidence screen shows every event and snapshot
entries.summary: Will run a real task through Tasks, Task, Approvals and Evidence.

entries.subject: m6-crew-in-bezl
entries.title: M6: Crew protocol in Bezl
entries.passMark: The five crew-test tasks, run inside Bezl, match or beat the harness results on every threshold
entries.summary: Will move the Crew protocol into Bezl, if the crew test passes.
